markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (79%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review
Invasive stays in the 90% conformal set (20%); 4 of 5 similar cases are Invasive [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 79%, Invasive 20% | Clear lead, real runner-up |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive | Cannot separate two classes |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.96 / 1.0 | Not flagged; simulated degradation |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Concordant |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 InSitu | Neighbors mostly disagree [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Scarce normal lobules** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score; largest concept-model term [F2] · Unreliable
- **Scarce benign stroma or fat** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score; second-largest concept-model term [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score; lowers invasive tilt [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score in these regions · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47 to 0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Gain over random is 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007), includes 0: unproven. Normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- The image is a simulated degraded frozen section (resample, severity 3); features may be distorted.
- Top concept terms rest on the Unreliable normal-lobule score; the conformal guarantee is dataset-level, not per case.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 7** — Highest heatmap contribution (0.41); look for stromal invasion beyond ducts.
2. **Regions 4, 5** — Is benign stroma scarce (4)? Are atypical cells confined to ducts (5)?
3. **Regions 3, 7, 8–11** — Confirm suggested tumor at inferior and lateral margins [F7].
